name: lottie-react
summary: An active React wrapper with good types and React 18/19 support. It is held because it depends on stale lottie-web 5.13.0, is JSON-only, has no npm provenance and inherits eval() in the browser bundle.
gains: SVG rendering works in the spike
losses: Depends on lottie-web 5.13.0, which has not shipped since May 2025
eval() in the inherited browser bundle
blockers: The chosen stack fails the 12-month active-maintenance constraint through lottie-web.

spike.scenario: 90-frame Lottie JSON, React 19.2.0, SVG renderer, Vite production build, 1200x800 Chrome screenshot.
spike.notes: The component reached SVG output in 56 ms. The bundle includes React 19.2.0; lottie-web is the bulk of it.
